lead: Shashi Tharoor is a widely followed Indian writer, born on 9 March 1956 in London.
As of 2026, he is 70 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He is associated with work such as Why I am a Hindu and has held the office of Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Shashi Tharoor: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Shashi Tharoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shashi Tharoor was born on 9 March 1956 in London, and holds Indian nationality.
His listed education includes St. Stephen's College, University of Delhi, Tufts University and The Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Shashi Tharoor — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists writer, politician, diplomat and jurist as his occupations, including work with United Nations.
Among the credits most often linked to Shashi are Why I am a Hindu.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–present), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–2024) and Member of the 18th Lok Sabha (2024–present). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
